about: The parts the question check must name when it refuses routing-2026-10-03.json with the mode at product-thinker (spc-2610030944505997 criterion A1). The question as asked carried no abcd header, and since decision 36 of itd-2610230756259215 a question with none is another tool's whatever the mode, so the fixture is rebuilt with the number header Q1 (spc-2610301917245442, step 3) and its other faults kept: one block, with no paragraph before the question and no Now: or Change later: line; the meaning of each option only in its preview, and so a side preview on each option (rule 14, the layout intent's decision 20); no decide-later option. Ten parts break the rules. The refusal names one line per rule and tab (spc-2610301917245442, step 2), each naming the first part that broke the rule and counting the rest: five lines, holding five more parts (two more descriptions, the second missing line and two more previews).
